V0参考：AI建议通过；‘账单国是美国’明确billing_country；分母仍缺，应问分母。补全库2024后gold FILTER分子/同期间全库分母正确。

V0系统回答：AI发现错误；实际问region_scope而未问denominator。原provider正确billing scope却程序explicit_region_scope不识别‘账单国’，覆盖为歧义；provider还先猜全部发票分母，虽然程序后续清掉。controller没有地区补充而止步，未执行。

{
  "gold_sql": "WITH customer_purchase AS (SELECT c.customer_id, SUM(i.total) AS purchase_amount FROM public.invoice i JOIN public.customer c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < DATE '2024-01-01' GROUP BY c.customer_id) SELECT cp.customer_id, cp.purchase_amount FROM customer_purchase cp ORDER BY cp.purchase_amount DESC, cp.customer_id ASC LIMIT 1;",

        "purchase_amount": "32.75"

原标签：冻结题库对应行

原参考SQL、标准结果、绑定、条件和控制器（实际读取）
{
  "gold_sql": "SELECT SUM(il.quantity) AS purchased_quantity FROM public.invoice_line il JOIN public.invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id JOIN public.track t ON t.track_id = il.track_id JOIN public.genre g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < DATE '2025-01-01' AND g.name = 'Rock';",
  "gold_result": {
    "columns": [
      "purchased_quantity"
    ],
    "rows": [
      [
        164
      ]
    ],
    "table": [
      {
        "purchased_quantity": 164
      }
    ],
    "row_count": 1,
    "truncated": false
  },
  "expected_behavior": "暂停澄清：摇滚同时有 Rock 与 Rock And Roll 两个 approved_candidate 候选，且 Rock And Roll 还带有来自方案的 available 候选；初次保留全部解释，不预选任一。补充明确流派后才执行。",
  "expected_bindings": [],

    {
      "column": "invoice.invoice_date",
      "operator": ">=",
      "value": "2024-01-01"

      "operator": "<",

    }
  ],

      "expression": "SUM(invoice_line.quantity)"
    },

      "end": "2025-01-01"
    }
  },
  "controller": {
    "hidden_goal": "统计2024年流派为 Rock 的曲目购买数量：SUM(invoice_line.quantity)，经 invoice.invoice_date 过滤，期间左闭右开。",

  ],

    "Rock 与 Rock And Roll 均为 approved_candidate，不是自动唯一绑定；单候选也需先澄清（approved_aliases_and_candidate_relations 中 review_status=approved_candidate）。"

V0系统回答：AI发现错误；实际只COUNT全部Brazil客户=5，SQL完全不使用2024，intent却显示2024；未经解释就忽略显式日期。正确值究竟5/4不能确定，应先澄清日期含义，不能把gold活跃客户4强作唯一。

    "hidden_goal": "计算2023年巴西居住客户发票销售额占当年全部发票销售额的比例。顾客国别用 customer.country；金额用 SUM(invoice.total)；零分母返回 NULL。",
